literal_meaning: জন (person) এর দ্বিত্বশব্দ; person by person
figurative_meaning_bn: প্রতিজনকে ভাবার্থে দ্বিত্বশব্দ; এক এক করে; প্রত্যেককে
figurative_meaning_en: one by one; each individually; every person
example_sentences_in_english: They came and sat one by one.
note: This is a common reduplicative expression in Bengali for emphasizing individuality or sequence.
